producer_description: Z5-invariant admissible three-star structures (stars 0,1,2; mates i^1; rho shifts the five mate pairs 4..13), first 10000 in cryptominisat enumeration order, those with T_S >= 0 and 7 Pi_S - T_S >= 0 (exact rank given). Labels indexed as in 'labels'.
spectral_certification_source: Producer: both Grams PSD, exact rank30, fixed grid. No repeated rank/PSD audit.
scope: This is the supplied finite batch, selected from the first10000 structures examined by the producer.
No exhaustive classification of all Z5 three-star structures is claimed.
No symmetry is assumed for a completion; each labelled boundary is excluded in any Conway graph.
No claim that the inputs are pairwise nonisomorphic is made.
A surviving first-column domain would be necessary only, not a completed graph.
arithmetic_scope: Both rank30 and the two initial PSD conditions come from the producer. All new completion rejection computations are exact.
